POV: “I’ll eat healthy tomorrow” starts right after this bite 😭  Creamy Cheesy Buldak Noodles 🌶️🧀 Ingredients 2 slices American cheese 1 slice baby Swiss cheese 2 tbsp ketchup 2 tbsp Kewpie mayo 1 tbsp chili oil (plus more for topping) 1 packet Buldak sauce and seasoning powder 2–3 tbsp chopped green onions (plus more for garnish) ½ cup heavy cream 1 packet Buldak noodles, boiled until half cooked Cooked dumplings, for topping Cooked sausage, sliced, for topping Instructions In a pan over low heat, add the American cheese and baby Swiss cheese. Add the ketchup, Kewpie mayo, chili oil, Buldak sauce, seasoning powder, and chopped green onions. Stir until the cheese melts and everything is well combined. Pour in the heavy cream and mix until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Add the half-cooked Buldak noodles and toss until every strand is coated in the rich, cheesy sauce. Top with cooked dumplings and sliced sausage. Finish with an extra drizzle of chili oil and more chopped green onions. Serve hot and enjoy! #r#ramenb#buldakr#Recipec#cookspicy

Who remembers the Chili’s restaurant in Rancho Mirage? Where would you want to see one now? Let me know 👇  Do you remember that shopping center before what it looks like now? The Rancho Las Palmas shopping center looked drastically different back in the early 2000’s through 2014. There was a Chili’s restaurant, Vons, Thai Smile, library, and Chamber of Commerce.  There was no direct access to the center from Highway 111. You had to enter on Bob Hope or Magnesia Falls and it’s been said that’s why those businesses struggled.  Chili’s closed, Vons relocated, Thai Smile relocated, CVS moved to the corner so they could have the drive thru pharmacy, a new library was built, the Chamber moved.  Now that center is home to an In n Out, a Starbucks, Hobby Lobby, Haus of Poke, Brandini Toffee, Pieology, and more. Stein Mart closed and Amazon Fresh was supposed to open.  @Chili’s Grill & Bar   #ranchomirage #coachellavalley #coachellavalleyrealestate #chilis #chilisbarandgrill

Growth is slow, but damage can happen fast. Be patient with the process. 10. Take progress photos. You see your hair every day, so it’s easy to miss the little improvements that add up over time. The biggest difference between girls who eventually have healthy hair and the ones who don’t? They don’t quit after two weeks. They keep showing up. Wash after wash. Brush after brush. This routine is for anyone who is not dealing with extreme damage but wants over all glossier & softer hair this is the the exact routine I built for getting glass hair on fine hair but will work for the wavy curly hair girls too!!  the science: the flatten your cuticle lies, the more light it reflects that's what gives the illusion of glass. glossy hair isn't a product, it's the consistency of routine over time that’s keeping that cuticle smooth from prewash to final styling  it took me a while to figure out the system, but once I did, the results compounded and now I wanna share my favourite tips with you because this is the routine that actually for every  wash day. the 5 things I never skip: 1. always create a barrier before shampoo: hair oil or conditioner first. less friction = less cuticle damage = more shine 2. weekly hair mask. deep hydration is what keeps that cuticle flat and the shine consistent. 3. a glossing treatment every 3-4 weeks  this is the step that takes glossy to glass  4. leave-in conditioner every single wash. beats frizz and keeps the cuticle flat between washes. 5. the hair sandwich method oil before heat styling AND after. then always finish with a cool shot to lock the cuticle in place ✨ Hope these haircare tips help you guys!! #hair #haircare #glasshair #hairgloss

“Dog lovers” vs dog lovers when it comes to greeting dogs! ETA: “dog lovers” could also be replaced with “uniformed, uneducated, and/or inconsiderate dog lovers” vs “informed, educated, and considerate dog lovers” if that makes you more comfortable 🫶 One of my biggest pet peeves is people baby talking to my dog and pretending like I’m interrupting? Bizarre! And in case you didn’t know because it’s something that’s been so normalized, putting your hands in dogs’ faces is unsafe. Dogs don’t need to sniff you up close like that and it’s putting unneeded pressure on them (often leading to bites). The best way to greet a dog is calm, neutral, and honestly just ignoring them. If you want to say hi to a dog, ask the owner first. Try to make yourself small by turning to the side and crouching. Allow the dog to approach you first. Some dogs are super friendly and love people! This doesn’t mean it’s ok to pet or approach without asking their handler! The safest way to greet any dog is by admiring from afar. Admittedly, if I know someone’s dog well, I might be a bit of the former “dog lover” and be excitedly greeting them 😂 It’s different when you know the dog!
